name: avatar-group-popover
title: Avatar group popover
description: Make the +5 on an avatar stack useful: press it to see everyone in a short list with name, role and presence, and filter when the list is long.
docs: Pass people ({ id, name, role, image, status }) in the order the stack should show them, and max (default 4): that many avatars are drawn, and the rest fold into a button named 'Show 5 more people' that opens the list of everyone; with no more people than max there is no button. Each visible avatar is an image with the person's name, and the whole stack is a group that reads as 'Maya Okafor and 6 others' ('A and B' for two). The list shows an avatar, the name, the role in muted text and the presence as a drawing and a word (online, away, busy, offline: a disc, a half disc, a ring with a bar, a ring), never colour alone. It is one tab stop with the arrow keys, Home and End, and it scrolls inside itself when it is long. searchable (default true) adds a filter field once there are more than eight people: Escape empties it before it closes the list, the arrow down goes to the first row, names are matched without capitals and accents, and a polite line says how many match. onSelect(person) makes the rows buttons and closes the list; without it the rows are plain text. viewAllHref adds a link at the foot, size is sm, default or lg, align picks the edge, open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the list, locale shapes the counts, and labels translates every word.
